//: Every environment variable that Node.js reads, and how the nodeOptions fuse treats it. build/check_node_env_vars.py fails the build when Node.js reads one that is not listed here. fuse-gated: removed in every process when the fuse is disabled (kFuseGated). inherited: removed at startup when the fuse is disabled, so only values the app sets reach child processes (kInherited). handled: covered by other code, see why. allowed: reviewed and left alone, see why.

HTTPS_PROXY.why: only read when NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY or --use-env-proxy is set

HTTP_PROXY.why: only read when NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY or --use-env-proxy is set

NODE_BENCH_CONTEXT.why: only read by the node:bench runner

NODE_BENCH_FILE_RUN_ID.why: only read by the node:bench runner

NODE_BENCH_RUN_ID.why: only read by the node:bench runner

NODE_CHANNEL_FD.why: set by child_process.fork() and utilityProcess; opens an IPC channel to the parent on the given descriptor

NODE_CHANNEL_SERIALIZATION_MODE.why: set by child_process.fork(); selects the IPC wire format for NODE_CHANNEL_FD

NODE_CLUSTER_SCHED_POLICY.why: only affects a process that calls cluster.fork()

NODE_DEBUG.why: prints debug logging for the listed core modules to stderr

NODE_DEBUG_NATIVE.why: prints debug logging for the listed native subsystems to stderr

NODE_ICU_DATA.why: ignored; ICU data is linked into the binary

NODE_INSPECT_RESUME_ON_START.why: only read by the node inspect debugger client

NODE_NO_READLINE.why: only read by the interactive REPL

NODE_OPTIONS.why: SetNodeOptions() in node_bindings.cc and kDisableNodeOptionsEnv apply the fuse and the packaged app rules

NODE_PATH.why: ignored outside ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE because Electron sets kNoGlobalSearchPaths

NODE_PENDING_PIPE_INSTANCES.why: tunes named pipe server backlog on Windows

NODE_REPL_HISTORY.why: only read by the interactive REPL

NODE_REPL_HISTORY_SIZE.why: only read by the interactive REPL

NODE_REPL_MODE.why: only read by the interactive REPL

NODE_SKIP_PLATFORM_CHECK.why: skips the minimum Windows version check at startup

NODE_TEST_CONTEXT.why: only read by the node:test runner

NODE_TEST_WORKER_ID.why: only read by the node:test runner

NODE_UNIQUE_ID.why: set by cluster.fork(); makes the process a cluster worker whose listen() is delegated to the parent

NODE_V8_COVERAGE.why: writes V8 coverage reports to the given directory at exit

NO_PROXY.why: only read when NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY or --use-env-proxy is set

OPENSSL_CONF.why: ignored; BoringSSL does not load a configuration file

SSL_CERT_DIR.why: only read with --use-openssl-ca, which BoringSSL builds do not support

SSL_CERT_FILE.why: only read with --use-openssl-ca, which BoringSSL builds do not support

USERPROFILE.why: only used for the HOME/.node_modules search path, which kNoGlobalSearchPaths disables

WATCH_REPORT_DEPENDENCIES.why: set by node --watch; makes the module loader report each loaded path to the parent over IPC
